items.title: Show Proof-or-stop on playback and exported video frames
items.context: Update the DOM playback heading and shared canvas export chrome; verify visible branding and retained story context.
items.userSees: Proof-or-stop in the playback/export header and every exported frame, alongside the story identity.

happy.desc: Opening timeline playback and completing its initialization both show the exact product name Proof-or-stop alongside the current story identifier and playback context.

edge.desc: Representative light and dark export frames at the supported MP4 and GIF dimensions display Proof-or-stop clearly while retaining the story identifier and timeline context without title overlap or clipping.

adversarial.desc: Advancing playback and rendering a later export frame retain the branding; heading refreshes must not replace it with an unbranded title, and existing story metadata remains legible.

verificationEvidence.note: Exempt automated browser replay for this cosmetic text-only change: actual CUA browser inspection confirmed initial/initialized Proof-or-stop · B-fe8f · timeline playback header. npm graph build and node --check passed. Existing manual browser attestation documents observations; no automated coverage is claimed.

Exempt automated pixel/layout assertion for this cosmetic change after real light MP4 1920x1080 and dark GIF 1440x810 exports were decoded and visually inspected by owner and independent reviewer. Both /private/tmp/proof-or-stop-brand-frame.png and /private/tmp/proof-or-stop-brand-dark.png show separate readable brand and story title. No machine visual coverage claimed.

Exempt automated replay for text-only branding after CUA inspection at transition 1 and 2, reopen and export reset, and decoded later frames MP4 12s/GIF 18s retained brand. Independent code inspection confirmed both heading assignments use the shared constant. No mechanical coverage claimed.
